insight: Free with any Microsoft account and built on DALL-E-lineage generation — its draws come from a monthly AI-credit allowance, not a flat plan.
name: Microsoft Designer
tagline: AI graphic design app for social posts, invites, and images.
description: Microsoft's AI-powered graphic design app that generates social media graphics, invitations, stickers, and images from a text prompt, with template suggestions and brand-aware editing. It includes AI image generation and editing, and is free with a Microsoft account on a monthly AI-credit allowance, with more credits for Microsoft 365 subscribers.

modelSupport.notes: Runs Microsoft's own image-generation and design models behind the app; no model picker.
